title: Postnatal Astrocyte Labeling by Electroporation (PALE)
author: Shiyi Wang
materials: Monitor pups until collection at P21.
Generate surface reconstructions of the astrocytes.
Analyze imaged astrocytes using Imaris Bitplane software.

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize late P0/early P1 wild-type CD1 mice by hypothermia.

steps.title: Prepare Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare plasmid DNA mixed with Fast Green Dye for visualization. For shRNA knockdown experiments, prepare 1 μl of DNA containing 1 μg of pGLAST-PBase and 1 μg of pPB-shRNA-mCherryCAAX for injection.

steps.title: Inject Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Inject 1 μl of plasmid DNA mixture into the lateral ventricle of one hemisphere using a pulled glass pipette (Drummond), maintaining sterile conditions.

steps.title: Perform Electroporation
steps.instruction: Apply electrical pulses to the pups using specific electrode orientation and parameters.

substeps.instruction: Orient electrodes with the positive terminal above the visual cortex and the negative terminal below the chin of the pups.
Apply 5 discrete 50 ms pulses of 100 V spaced 950 ms apart.

steps.title: Recover Pups
steps.instruction: Recover pups on a heating pad. Return mouse to home cage once it has regained pink color and is breathing and moving around.

steps.title: Perform Perfusion and Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix the brain tissue through transcardial perfusion and post-fixation.

substeps.instruction: Perform transcardial perfusion using TBS/Heparin followed by 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA).
Remove the brain and post-fix it in 4% PFA overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Cryoprotect and Embed Brain
steps.instruction: Prepare the brain for sectioning through cryoprotection and embedding.

substeps.instruction: Cryoprotect the brain in 30% sucrose solution until sunk.
Embed the brain in a solution containing 2 parts 30% sucrose and 1 part O.C.T. (TissueTek).
Store the brain blocks at −80°C until sectioning.

steps.title: Section and Store Brain
steps.instruction: Create coronal slices and store them for later use.

substeps.instruction: Section the brain into 100 μm thick coronal slices using a cryostat.
Store the sections in a 1:1 mixture of TBS and glycerol at −20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Sections for Staining
steps.instruction: Wash and block the brain sections containing the visual cortex.

substeps.instruction: Wash the brain sections in 1x TBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (TBST).
Examine brain sections for the presence of electroporated cells.
Block non-specific binding by incubating sections in 10% normal goat serum (NGS) diluted in TBST for 01:00:00 at Room temperature.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with rabbit anti-RFP primary antibody (1:1,000) diluted in blocking buffer (10% NGS in TBST) for 3 nights at 4 °C with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash and Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Wash sections and apply nuclear stain.

substeps.instruction: Wash sections with TBST (3x 10 min).
Add DAPI (1:50,000) to the second wash for nuclear staining.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in Alexa Fluor 594 goat anti-rabbit IgG(H+L) secondary antibodies diluted 1:200 in TBST for 03:00:00 at Room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wash sections with TBST after incubation.

steps.title: Mount Sections
steps.instruction: Transfer and mount the sections onto glass slides.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sections one by one to a container filled with 2/3 TBS and 1/3 ddH2O.
Mount sections (3 per slide) using a clean brush on glass slides.
Allow sections to dry for approximately 5-10 min.
Mount sections using homemade mounting media (90% Glycerol, 20 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.5% n-Propyl gallate).
Seal the edges of the coverslip with nail polish.

steps.title: Image Acquisition
steps.instruction: Acquire high-resolution images of individual astrocytes.

substeps.instruction: Wait at least 02:00:00 after mounting before imaging to allow sections to settle.
Use a fluorescence microscope (e.g., Olympus FV 3000) with a 60x objective and 2x zoom.
Acquire images with a 0.5 μm step size, ensuring the entire astrocyte is captured within a single brain section.

steps.title: Analyze Astrocyte Territories
steps.instruction: Quantify astrocyte territory and perform statistical analysis.

substeps.instruction: Use Imaris Xtensions “Visualize Surface Spots” and “Convex Hull” to create surface renders of each astrocyte territory.
Record the volume of each astrocyte territory.
Analyze territory sizes from biological replicates across experimental conditions.
Perform statistical comparisons using a nested t test or nested two-way ANOVA followed by the Bonferroni posthoc test.
